patch_description: Replace the linear CZ chain with a brick-wall pattern (even pairs then odd pairs + wrap-around). This creates full ring connectivity in two entangling sub-layers, allowing information to flow between all qubits more efficiently. The parameter count stays at 24 per block (same as seed), but the entanglement structure is significantly improved. The brick-wall pattern is known to have better expressibility and trainability compared to linear chains for the same circuit depth.
